relevance_note: Describes four individually tabulated patients with biallelic SLC2A10 variants: 'Four cases of ATS from two families are described'.
method_note: The PMID header points to the Research Square preprint (posted 2023-02-22); first author and year come from it. Table 1 has patients as columns (headers 'Patient 1'..'Patient 4'); a script sliced each row up to the patient's cell to make the spans, and the output was checked against the table by eye. Spans longer than 300 characters were split into [row label, cell]. '+' cells were recorded observed; empty cells not reported; cells reading 'Absent' (Arterial stenosis, Cardiomyopathy) excluded. Mapping: the text's 'Proband 1' is Patient 1 (Family 1 column, c.510G>A, siblings patient 2 and 3) and 'Proband 2' is Patient 4 (Family 2, compound heterozygous); this mapping is inferred from matching variants and families, not stated in one sentence. Table 1 leaves the Family, cDNA, protein, variant type and zygosity cells empty for Patients 2 and 3 (possibly merged cells not repeated by the conversion); their variant and zygosity come from the abstract and the co-segregation sentence; variant type left not reported for them. In the 'Hypoplasia of corpus callosum' row the Patient 1 cell repeats the row label instead of a symbol (conversion artefact?); recorded not reported for Patient 1. Parents of Patient 1 (also parents of Patients 2 and 3) were tested heterozygous and get rows; parents of Patient 4 were tested ('both variants were in trans') and get individual rows but no variant rows, because the paper does not say which parent carries which variant. Inheritance left not reported for the homozygous patients (both parents heterozygous; no enum value for biallelic inheritance) and for Patient 4 (in trans, carrier parent per variant not stated). In silico predictions for c.899T>G were not treated as functional evidence. Discussion counts (aortic root dilation in 2/4, severe abdominal tortuosity in 2/4, supra-aortic 4/4) are unnamed and were not assigned. Patient 4 'Right pulmonary artery kinked at the origin' sits in the Arterial stenosis row but the abstract says the only focal stenosis was renal; pulmonary artery stenosis left not reported for Patient 4. Arterial stenosis 'Absent' was used to exclude pulmonary artery stenosis and aortic/branch stenosis for Patients 1-3. Figure 1A hydronephrosis is not attributed to a named patient and was not recorded. Country (Morocco) recorded only for Patient 1, whose parents are described; not carried to the siblings. The '>' entities in text-derived variant strings are kept as printed in the Markdown.
